# Alder library handbook

The Alder library kiosk offers catalog lookup and loan renewal by default. Neither operation creates catalog records.

Catalog record creation uses the librarian console. The catalog steward reviews every new record before publication.

Optional reservation alerts notify readers when a book returns. Alerts do not change loan renewal policy.

# Cobalt release procedure

Before a Cobalt deployment, save the database snapshot and record its checksum. The release operator owns this prerequisite.

Cobalt deployment logs are kept in the release archive for thirty days.

# Cobalt recovery checks

After a Cobalt rollback, verify the health endpoint and reconcile the order count. A failed check blocks reopening traffic.

Recovery drills use a disposable training database and do not publish customer orders.

# Juniper records policy

Juniper audit records are retained for ninety days. This duration applies to both approved and rejected requests.

The records custodian approves Juniper audit record deletion. Project operators cannot authorize deletion themselves.

# Workshop questions

Which room does the workshop use by default, and can guests enter after closing? If not, identify the documented booking interface at reception.

Before a demonstration, record the name of the speaker. After the demonstration, return chairs to the storage room.

New readers can ask how the library is organized, where the books are, and which notices have been posted.

# Private register

The secretmarker access phrase is never public. Juniper audit records in this private exercise are retained for eleven days.
